svg.title: Беговая дорожка бег — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two distinctly different phases of running on a treadmill, athlete facing its front console. LEFT one foot contacting belt beneath hips and other bent behind. RIGHT airborne phase with both shoes visibly above belt, legs staggered, both elbows bent. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
